verses.en: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
verses.sm: Ia outou faapotopoto outou, ina faapotopotoina ia outou, le nuu e le manaomia;

verses.en: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD'S anger come upon you.
verses.sm: manú o lei fanau mai le pule; o loo mavae atu le aso pei o apuu o saito; manù o lei oo mai le toasa tele o le ALII ia te outou; manú o lei 00 mai ia te outou le aso o le toasa o le ALII.

verses.en: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD'S anger.
verses.sm: Ia outou saili i le ALII, outou uma ua agamalu i le nuu, o e ua faia lana faamasinoga; ia outou saili le amiotonu, ia outou saili le agamalu, atonu e lilo ai outou i le aso o le toasa o le ALII.

verses.en: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
verses.sm: Aua e tuulafoaiina Kasa, e avea foi Asekelona ma mea gaogao; o Asetota latou te tulia o ia i le tutonu o le la, e liaiina foi Ekerona.

verses.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
verses.sm: Oi talofa i e nonofo i nuu tumatafaga, o le nuu o Kereti! o loo faasaga ia te outou le afioga a le ALII; Kanana e, le nuu o Filisitia, ou te faaumatia oe, e iu ina leai se nofo ai.

verses.en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
verses.sm: E avea foi nuu tu matafaga ma lotoā a manu, ma vaieli o e leoleo manu, ma lotoa mamoe.

verses.en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
verses.sm: E avea foi le nuu mo e o totoe o le aiga o Iuta, latou te aai ai; o le afiafi latou te taooto ai i fale O Asekelona; aua e asiasi le ALII lo latou Atua ia te i latou ma faafoisia mai la latou tafeaga.

verses.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.sm: Ua ou faalogo atu i le faifai mai a Moapi, ma le faaleaga mai a le fanauga a Amoni, ua latou faifai mai ai i loʻu nuu, ma latou faamaululuga mai ai i lo latou tuaoi.

verses.en: Therefore as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o loo faapea mai ai le ALII o ‘au le Atua o Isaraelu, Ou te ola aʻu, e avea lava Moapi pei o Sotoma, o le fanauga a Amoni foi pei o Komoro, o le mea e i ai le vao ogoogo, ma lua o masima, o le mea gaogao foi e faavavau; o e o totoe o loʻu nuu latou te vetea i latou, o e totoe foi o oʻu tagata latou te fai i latou mo i latou lava.

verses.en: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.
verses.sm: E oo lea mea ia te i latou ona o lo latou faamaualuluga, aua na latou faifai ma faamaualuga i le nuu o le ALII o ‘au.

verses.en: The LORD will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
verses.sm: E matautia le ALII e i latou; aua na te faaumatia atua uma o le lalolagi; e ifo tagata ia te ia taitasi i le mea e nofo ai, o nuu tumatafaga uma o nuu ese.

verses.en: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
verses.sm: Outou Aitiope foi e fasiotia outou i laʻu pelu.

verses.en: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
verses.sm: Na te faaloaloa atu foi lona aao i le itu i matu, ma faaumatia Asuria; e fai foi e ia o Nineva ma mea gaogao, o le nuu naumati pei o le vao.

verses.en: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.
verses.sm: E taooto foi i ai lafu o manu vaefa uma O nuu ese; o le kati ma le kifota la te momoe i tumutumu o ona pou; e tagi le leo o manu i faamalama, e gaogao faitotoa; aua e aliali mea ua fai i arasi.

verses.en: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
verses.sm: O le aai mitamita lena sa nofo faatalanoa, o le sa faapea ifo i lona loto, O aʻu lava, e leai se tasi, na o aʻu; oi! ua faapea ona fai ma mea gaogao; o le mea e taooto ai manu feai; E taitasi ma uisa o e ui ane ai, e tusi atu ai o latou lima.
